title: Google invests about $1.3B more in Anthropic

sources.quote: In August 2024, the Company entered into an additional note purchase agreement (“Google 2024 NPA”) with Google for the issuance of a convertible promissory note in an aggregate principal amount of approximately $1.3 billion.

explain: Google added about $1.3 billion to Anthropic in a convertible note signed in August 2024 (the filing gives only the month, so the date here is the first of August). The note became Anthropic shares in 2025.
